facts.statement: Free Realms was shown in action to a couple of media outlets at CES 2009 in Las Vegas.
facts.quote: Over at CES 2009 in Las Vegas, a couple media outlets had an opportunity to see Sony Online Entertainment's upcoming kid-focused MMO

article_summaries.title: Preview of Free Realms from CES
article_summaries.summary: A pre-launch hands-on preview from CES 2009 of Sony Online Entertainment's kid-focused MMO Free Realms, covering its mini-games and job switching. It describes a build shown to media, not the shipped game, and notes the PS3 version would likely get control revisions. Treat all details as pre-launch plans.
